messages:
ci-bot: Build #9855 (eng-infra / PR 4021) failed on ubuntu-latest (py39) — pytest errors in tests/test_crypto_integration.py::test_encrypt_decrypt. Logs: ImportError: cannot import name 'X509' from 'cryptography.x509' — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/9855
anya: seeing same locally when I run the py39 container, reproduces 100% for me :eyes:
mohit: any recent lockfile/poetry changes in that PR? who authored 4021?
anya: PR 4021 is by @anya, main change was a `poetry update` to resolve a transitive constraint in requests; lockfile was updated in the branch.
sam: can you paste `poetry show` / `python -c` output for cryptography?
anya: sure, quick snippet:
```
$ poetry show cryptography
cryptography 41.0.2 A general crypto library

$ python -c "import cryptography; print(cryptography.__version__)"
41.0.2
```
mohit: that's suspicious — we've been running 40.x in CI for a while. 41.x changed a few build defaults recently. try pinning to 40.x locally and rerun?
jamie: I can try a local bisect but need a reproducible minimal command. CI artifact shows wheel resolution errors: "No matching distribution found for cryptography==41.0.2 (from -r requirements.txt (line 7))" — maybe manylinux tag mismatch.
rowan: also check setuptools/wheel versions in the runner image. Did setuptools bump in the lock update?
anya: lockfile diff highlights a few transitive bumps: asn1crypto 1.5.0 -> 1.5.1, urllib3 2.1.0, and something pulled cryptography to 41. I didn't touch setuptools.
sam: plan: 1) revert lockfile locally to previous lock and run the py39 job; 2) if revert fixes, bisect lockfile commits to find offending transitive pin; 3) temporary mitigation: pin cryptography==40.* in CI to get green.
mohit: I can push the CI pin if someone approves; prefer to bisect first to avoid masking root cause. can someone run git bisect on the lockfile commits? I don't have my workstation atm.
anya: I can run the bisect tomorrow morning. For now I pushed a quick PR hotfix branch (4021-hotfix-cryptopins) that constrains cryptography = ">=40,<41" in pyproject.toml and re-ran CI.
jamie: re-run of #9855 after the hotfix still failed because it's the original PR job. I triggered a rerun of the new branch build too.
sam: re-run of the hotfix build (9862) is queued — if it passes we can merge the hotfix to unblock main and then do bisect post-merge.
rowan: I'll open an infra ticket to check our wheel caches and manylinux compatibility, in case this is a broader runner image issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-459
mohit: thanks. if bisect points to urllib3 or asn1crypto bump we may need to pin those or update our docker image.
anya: I'll add notes to PR 4021 describing the temporary pin and the bisect plan. will post bisect result and a repro docker image link here once done. :pray:
ci-bot: Build #9855 rerun requested by sam — status: queued (job 9870).
